blocks.caption:
FREELANCE VIDEO DIRECTOR & PHOTOGRAPHER BASED IN LONDON, UK, FOCUSED ON STORYTELLING WITH A UNIQUE PERSPECTIVE. I ALWAYS TRY TO GO DOWN UNCOMMON ROUTES WHEN CREATING BOTH MY VIDEOS AND IMAGERY, AND I CHOOSE TO FOCUS ON REAL PEOPLE AND WHAT GOES ON BELOW THE SURFACE. SOCIETY , TRAVELLING, SPORT & URBAN CULTURE ARE SOME OF MY MAIN INFLUENCES.

GEORGE GARNISH

GEORGEGARNISH@YAHOO.CO.UK
